verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and internally consistent. The amendment repeatedly limits L1 to an unexecuted prerequisite/compiler-mechanism specification, explicitly says it cannot guard later changes to the patched BoundedVec::push path, and leaves L2 unresolved and non-verdict-producing until its dependent-witness problem is solved. The three-run L1 matrix is non-vacuous as specified: honest and forged-in-range witnesses must verify, while the forged-out-of-range witness must be rejected. The companion program preserves the same limitations and keeps the real-path guard unimplemented, unrun, and blocking. Claims remain appropriately research-grade and do not present measurements or external-audit-level soundness. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff.
